map.Kind: kind (lower case); Figma only: Muted, Now playing; code also: now-playing

kind.about: volume (a level and a number, or Muted), now-playing (a title, a line and progress) or message.

value.about: 0 to 100: the volume, or how far through the now-playing item.

muted.about: Volume only: shows the slashed speaker and the word Muted.

label.about: Now playing: the title. Message: the text.

paused.about: Now playing: paused (the pause mark and the word Paused).

open.about: Shown. It fades after `timeout` unless `persist` is set.

timeout.about: Milliseconds before it fades (at least 1000; 3000 by default).
